about.title: About Kinetix Mod Manager
about.body:
Kinetix Mod Manager
Version: {0}
Publisher: Audi Venture Games
Website: https://github.com/SeanTerry01/Kinetix-Mod-Manager

Kinetix Mod Manager is a fully keyboard-driven, screen-reader-accessible mod manager for {1}. It is built for the blind and visually impaired gaming community, with spoken feedback, full keyboard control, and audio cues throughout.

With it you can install and manage your mods, check for and apply updates through Nexus Mods, discover new mods, save and switch between mod profiles, keep automatic backups, browse an accessible game wiki, and read the log your game's mod loader writes.

Kinetix Mod Manager works with NVDA, JAWS, and SAPI-based screen readers via Tolk.

Copyright (C) 2026 Audi Venture Games.
Provided as-is for personal and community use.

Your game is version {0}, but the Address Library only has data up to version {1}. {2} itself is fine — the problem is one step below it. Mods with a DLL plugin that uses the Address Library, which usually includes the accessibility mod, the Mod Configuration Menu and the crash logger, will be skipped and the game will start without them saying anything.

This is not something your setup can fix: it needs the Address Library's author to publish a version for {0}, and every mod with its own DLL plugin needs the same. Until then the game runs, but largely unmodded.

Launch anyway?

help.modPriority: Mod Priority: this list decides which mod's files win when two mods change the same file. The mod at the top of the list has the highest priority and wins. help.pluginOrder: Plugin Order: this is the load order of your plugin files, the dot e s p, dot e s m, and dot e s l files, written to plugins dot t x t. Plugins higher in the list load first. Masters and light masters always load before regular plugins, and the base game and its add-ons load automatically and are not listed here. Use the Up and Down arrows to move through the list, and Control plus Up or Control plus Down to move the selected plugin earlier or later. A plugin cannot move across the boundary between masters and regular plugins. Press {0} to auto-sort, which arranges every plugin to load after the masters it needs. Press {1} to hear how many plugin slots you are using, since the game can load only 255 regular plugins.
help.gameLog: Log: View the logs your game and its script-extender plugins write, such as f4se dot log, the per-mod logs, and your accessibility mod's log. Use the Log dropdown to choose which file to view, the Filter dropdown for Full Log or Errors and Warnings, and the Search box to find text. Arrow through the lines. {0} refreshes the log, even while the game is running. Control C copies the selected lines. {1} opens the raw file.
help.creations: Creations: Bethesda Creations are downloaded inside the game from its Creations menu, or queued from the Bethesda dot net website, never by a mod manager.
